mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate being positive (a constant condition) indicates a functioning monetary policy framework that supports equity market stability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS is positive is negative (p-value > 0.05 for positive mean).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 2% signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls by more than 2% in a month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls >= 0.1pp and PAYEMS falls >= 0.1%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized and FEDFUNDS rises, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1100 units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1100, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls > 2% and RSAFS falls > 2%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2% annualized), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market and economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL < 2% annualized and HOUST rises, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
